name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Personal attention retains bounded work snapshots with separate truncation flags. Only blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivered review takes precedence. Each queue row carries whose_move (you, reviewer, coordinator or unknown, relative to the caller) and next, one sentence from the validated review state: changes requested is the caller's work until a revision that supersedes the contribution answers each item; once delivered and unanswered it owes only the responses; review and integration belong to the reviewer/coordinator; a caller whose checkpoint records a blocker or dependency is quoted in its own words, escaped, no person inferred, and move and count stay the caller's. next_actor is that decision's caller-neutral role (never null; operator for a malformed row). Own-move items sort first; your_move counts every reconciled row, not the page. next-actions answer carries the two fields only where kind is changes-requested, built by the same function. claimable is one bounded rule, never an epic, decision, gate, job, record anchor or decision label. Flagged in-progress tasks sort first before the action cap; errors and unknown counts never imply idle.
